TikTok Shop product search API initial release.

- Search TikTok Shop products with exact prices.
- Retrieve detailed product information, reviews with star histogram, and the global category tree.
- Browse products by category or seller, and fetch seller catalogs.
- Resolve any TikTok Shop link (including share links and short links) to product or shop IDs.
- Eight endpoints available; all return structured JSON and cost 1 credit per call.
- Requires a SCAVIO_API_KEY for authentication.
